text_en: Well, if it isn't the General's lapdog!
Oh, shush! Don't get offended, I wasn't being serious.
There's not really any other choice than obeying the higher-ups.
By the way, since you're always galavanting around this world...
I didn't ever imagine asking you a favour, but if you help me, I'll teach you a trick I think you'll like.
Ha! Spoken like a true soldier of Zarga! Of course!
Listen, there's a mineral called <color=OBJ>garnerock</color>. It's extremely tough but very light and flexible at the same time.
In fact, one of my daggers is made from the very same material.
Exactly! You're a clever one, ain't ya? Garnerock is mainly used to make weapons.
But it's a rare material and not at all easy to find which makes the cost of these weapons sky high.
Some time ago, someone entrusted me with these daggers but, stupidly, I lost one of them.
I wonder if garnerock exists in this world..._100_ It might be a common mineral here or even more abundant than back home.
Either way, if you see someone carrying a weapon with a red blade or something similar, try to find those fragments and being them to me.
You know where to find me. If you have something, I'll be waiting.
